Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang joins Joe Rogan for episode 2422 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Huang co-founded the chip company that became the engine of the AI boom and one of the world's most valuable firms. His leather jacket and long talks are famous across tech.

Huang explains how graphics chips turned into the brains of modern AI. He shares his view of where computing, robots, and science go next. Rogan asks what this power shift means for jobs and daily life. Tech-minded and curious listeners get silicon's top leader holding court at length.
